FORMAT 1

[2026-08-17] update | The Paladin joins the roster
The Paladin is live. It is the ninth playable class on the server and the first addition to the roster since Witchblade, sitting at class code 9 alongside the eight the game shipped with.

You will need the current client for it. Older installs do not have the Paladin art or its skill icons and will not show the class on the character creation screen at all -- run Launcher.exe once and it will bring itself up to date.

[2026-08-01] announcement | Welcome to SUN Reborn
SUN Reborn is a progressive Soul of the Ultimate Nation server. You start at level one, the cap is sixty, and the rates are the ones the game was designed around.

The cash shop is priced at zero across the board and every account carries the premium flag. There is nothing to buy, so there is nothing to lose by playing for free -- because free is the only tier there is.
